findings.description: The shortcut raises ValueError when max / multiplier underflows to zero, instead of returning the capped wait.
findings.rationale: For wait_exponential(multiplier=1e308, max=1e-308) on attempt 1, all preceding guards pass, but the division rounds to 0.0 and math.log(0.0, 2) raises ValueError outside the try block. Previously the calculation returned 1e-308, so this valid configuration now aborts retry processing.
